sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months 
as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The purpose of the soot blowing
system (1/unit) is to clean the soot's deposits from the exterior surfaces of the
boiler, super heater, reheaters, economizer and air preheatrs blowing frequency
is determined by visual inspection of boiler surface by monitoring steam
temperature
Technical data:

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head 
sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh 
Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety category

Safety fence like ropes with
caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of P/P
motor

Disconnect electric terminals of
the motor

Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months 
as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The purpose of the soot blowing
system (1/unit) is to clean the soot's deposits from the exterior surfaces of the
boiler, super heater, reheaters, economizer and air preheatrs blowing frequency
is determined by visual inspection of boiler surface by monitoring steam
temperature
